title: Points of Judgement: A Refused Claim Entered Above the Value of the Piece
content:
Where a claim refused on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans stands entered for more than the value the covered piece is taken at, the figure the refusal is recorded at is not the amount claimed.

Where the amount the claim stands entered for is above the value the piece is taken at and a settlement entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, the figure is the value the piece is taken at less the benefit drawn in that coverage year. Where the amount the claim stands entered for is above the value the piece is taken at and no settlement entry stands on the plan inside the coverage year in progress, the figure is the value the piece is taken at. In any other case the figure is the amount the claim stands entered for.

## The cases distinguished

| The amount the claim stands entered for | Settlement entries inside the coverage year in progress | The figure the refusal is recorded at |
|---|---|---|
| above the value the piece is taken at | one or more | the value the piece is taken at, less the benefit drawn in that coverage year |
| above the value the piece is taken at | none | the value the piece is taken at |
| at or below the value the piece is taken at | any | the amount the claim stands entered for |

## Worked readings

A claim entered for 4000.00 USD on a piece taken at 3000.00 USD, with benefit of 800.00 USD drawn by settlements inside the coverage year in progress: the figure is 3000.00 USD less 800.00 USD, being 2200.00 USD. The same claim where no settlement entry stands inside that coverage year: the figure is 3000.00 USD. A claim entered for 2500.00 USD on that same piece is not above the value the piece is taken at, so the figure is 2500.00 USD.
